title: Company overlay: overlay.json and company records
description: The company index never redefines a public node; every record attaches to public IDs with a declared relation (design doc: Company index).

iac.description: The company's IaC repositories, each path relative to the overlay root (for example ../iac/<repo>). An infrawright repo holds JSON that pointers address by JSON Pointer; a terraform repo holds HCL, which is never parsed: a pointer names a file and, optionally, a resource address.

pointer.description: A place in one of the overlay's IaC repositories, named by the repo's id. In an infrawright repo: a JSON Pointer into a JSON file, resolved and merged at resolve time, never copied. In a terraform repo: a file and, optionally, a resource address, reported as a location.

address.description: A Terraform resource address in the file, for example zia_url_filtering_rules.block_gambling.

ref.description: case, vendor-call, vendor-ticket, vendor-email: a path relative to the runtime-data mount root (for example cases/<dir>/journal.md); public-doc: an https URL. The resolver does not read it.

do_not_infer.description: The record's boundary: what it does not establish. Shown verbatim wherever the record is used.

validated.description: The day the record was last checked against reality (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for claims and procedures.

map.description: Public field ID -> company representation (e.g. a Splunk field name).

record.description: Kind/relation pairing and relation-target rules (narrows/contradicts only against claims; scope required) are enforced in kb-lib validateCompanyRecord, because they depend on resolved node kinds.
